title: The Aftermath of the coast road
author: Orsen Crane
blurb: Noor Halloran, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
